label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, while the policy moderately favours a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass), only when the reward input is 0 (previous trial unrewarded), and almost only when the model policy at that step leans to a1 with moderate confidence (choice logit diff about 3..8; never when it favours a2 or is extremely confident). Equivalent observed alternative: upcoming action == a1 (recall 0.98, F1 0.32). The predicate covers ~100% of activations and mass but precision is only ~0.22: the unit is a thresholded gate and most such D1 steps stay below threshold. Rate rises with episode trial (rare in trials 0-9, peak 60-89), after a rare transition to S2 (prev_state == 2, ~0.8 of mass), with good == S1, and with consecutive unrewarded trials (activation grows over runs of r0); adding ep_trial >= 40 or prev_state == 2 raises F1 only to ~0.43. Never fires at GO or D2, after rewarded trials, or when the agent is about to pick a2.
